meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 处理Git提交与历史调查：按仓库风格分组、分阶段提交并写提交信息；调查时用blame、bisect、reflog等工具定位改动并引证据；重写历史时保护分支、用--force-with-lease并解决冲突。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查Git历史时触发（如提交、查谁改的、rebase等）；普通代码编辑除非用户明确要求Git操作，否则不触发。

say.text: 把这几个文件的改动拆成两个提交，按仓库现有提交风格写信息。
say.note: 进入提交模式，按原子组拆分并检测风格。

say.text: 用git blame查一下src/main.js第10到20行最近是谁改的。
say.note: 进入历史模式，用blame定位并给出证据。

say.text: 把当前分支最近三个提交squash成一个，用fixup方式。

howto.what_en: Handles Git commits and history investigation: groups and stages changes by repo style, writes commit messages; uses blame, bisect, reflog to trace changes and cite evidence; protects branches and uses --force-with-lease when rewriting history.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or Git-history investigation (e.g. committing, asking who changed a line, rebase); ordinary code edits do not trigger unless the user explicitly asks for Git work.

say_en.text: Split these changes into two commits and follow existing commit style.
say_en.note: Enters commit mode, splits atomic groups and detects style.

say_en.text: Use git blame to see who last changed lines 10-20 of src/main.js.
say_en.note: Enters history mode, uses blame and cites evidence.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits on this branch into one, using fixup.
say_en.note: Enters rebase mode and rewrites history with autosquash.
